highlights.title: Icelanders vote in referendum on whether to resume EU membership talks
highlights.summary: Iceland will vote in a tight referendum on Saturday on whether to reopen membership negotiations with the European Union. Reykjavik applied for EU membership in 2009, following a financial crisis that devastated its economy but a eurosceptic government suspended the process in 2013.

highlights.title: Fóssil de criatura de 324 milhões de anos com 24 membros e apenas 49 milímetros é descoberto
highlights.summary: Patas traseiras da criatura de 324 milhões de anos se assemelham a brânquias, sugerindo vida em ambientes aquáticos e posterior adaptação

highlights.summary: Apesar do recorde, o Tiangong Ultra tem um estilo de corrida diferente e mostrou instabilidade, com um pequeno incêndio após a prova

highlights.title: Onça-parda é capturada nos fundos de uma residência no RS
highlights.summary: Polícia Ambiental realizou a ação nesta sexta-feira (28), após o animal ser encontrado nos fundos de uma casa em Inhacorá

highlights.title: Gunfire and explosions heard near military base in Niger's capital
highlights.summary: Local residents heard gunfire and explosions overnight in Niger’s capital, Niamey, near a military base at an international airport which was attacked twice this year by jihadists.

highlights.title: Six months into the Iran war, a new Gulf security architecture is emerging
highlights.summary: Gulf states are building overlapping partnerships that complement, rather than replace, the US security role.
